newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania savings bank deposits up in January.
newsitem.headline: Romania savings bank deposits up in January.

text.p: Deposits at Romania's Casa de Economii si Consemnatiuni (CEC) savings bank rose slightly by 2.1 percent in January, to 2.6 trillion lei, CEC data showed.
Starting February 1, the bank's one-year rates went up by 14 percentage points to 54 percent, while its lending rates rose to an annual 59 percent from 47 percent.
CEC president Constantin Teculescu said CEC would hike the interest rates again, in line with other rates on the market.
Commercial banks' one-year deposit rates are currently between 56 percent and 80 percent.
